title: Butter
author: Gene Hubert
notes: The Caller's Box 10320, permission: full. **FR-C2 halved this dance's own shift.** "Shift left" moves half a couple width - one dancer position, 20 px - since DD54, so `startPlaces` puts every dancer half a couple place back rather than a whole one and `slide-left`'s default `alongPx` is `PLACE_PITCH_PX`. Measured before -> after at every checked length (4-12): closure, reach and collision unchanged and green (0.0000, 0.0000, 8.500 px); **`progressed` 0.0000 everywhere**, where at the odd lengths it read **68.0000** and nothing said so (M9f's finding). The slide itself is **20.0 -> 10.0 px/beat** over its two beats (hand 30.2 -> 17.6, elbow 30.2 -> 15.6), and the `wait-out` it sets up is **28.7 -> 15.3 px/beat** of travel (hand 61.9 -> 53.6, elbow 66.5 -> 60.7, elbow-per-hand 1.95x -> 1.76x) - so E27's `wait-out travel` allowlist row, the fastest sustained travel in the programme, has nothing left to allow and is deleted.
